topic: Rupee cost averaging in plain words

slides.headline: Same amount every month. Different units each time.
slides.subhead: Why a SIP buys more units when prices are lower.

slides.title: Rupee cost averaging in plain words

points.title: Fixed amount
points.text: You invest the same rupees every month.

points.title: Prices change
points.text: Lower prices buy more units. Higher prices buy fewer.

points.title: Smoother entry
points.text: Spreading purchases over time means you need not time the market.

slides.headline: Let the calendar do the timing
slides.cta: Save this for your next SIP review
slides.footnote: This explains a method. It does not promise any result.

caption: A SIP invests the same amount at regular intervals. When prices are lower you get more units, and when prices are higher you get fewer. That is rupee cost averaging. #RupeeCostAveraging #SIP #MutualFunds #InvestingBasics #SouthIndia
